additional_concerns: The request-trigger formula establishes only activation under the stipulated reading. TRUE does not establish demonstration, SFC satisfaction, confirmation, operational soundness or proper records; FALSE does not excuse continuing duties.

Footnote 5's unqualified wording supports a possible rival reading of demonstration. The formula preserves the expressly selected request-conditioned reading without resolving that alternative or the reach of the high-confidence qualification.
Paragraphs 15 and 16 have separate request conditions. A paragraph 14 demonstration request does not automatically require third-party verification or a legal opinion.

The accountability candidate supplies no executable meaning or complete standard of effective retention. Practical authority and supervisory conduct require evidence; neither defective records alone nor retained legal responsibility alone settles effective retention.

Section 6.11C concerns third-party valuation. Its supervision standard is not established as a tokenisation safe harbour. Intermediary obligations likewise require their own role and activity conditions.

The complete paragraphs 10–13, applicable Appendix factors and footnote 2 are not supplied. Their absence limits assessment of substantive compliance, although it does not itself defeat the narrowly stipulated request-trigger calculation.
The supplied structural and retrieval checks establish neither legal applicability nor actual facts. No actual SFC request or provider-specific accountability evidence is supplied.
